content.text:
Perfect! All 44 tests pass. I've added two line management functions to `src/invoices.js`:

**`addLine(invoice, { sku, qty })`** — adds or updates a line on a draft invoice
- If SKU doesn't exist, adds a new line at the end (enriched from catalogue)
- If SKU exists, increases that line's qty
- Validates qty (QTY_INVALID) and SKU (UNKNOWN_SKU) like `createInvoice`
- Refuses if invoice status isn't 'draft' (NOT_DRAFT)
- Returns `ok(newInvoice)`, never mutates original

**`removeLine(invoice, sku)`** — removes a line from a draft invoice
- Returns `ok(newInvoice)` with that line removed
- Returns LINE_NOT_FOUND if SKU not on invoice
- Returns NO_LINES if it would remove the last line
- Refuses if invoice status isn't 'draft' (NOT_DRAFT)
- Never mutates original

Added two new error codes to `src/errors.js`:
- NOT_DRAFT
- LINE_NOT_FOUND

Added 15 comprehensive tests covering all functionality, validation, error cases, and input immutability.
